pattern_name_ar: الماضي البسيط — الأفعال الشاذة و did/didn't
formula: Positive: irregular past (went, saw) · Negative: didn't + base · Question: Did + subject + base?
when_to_use: Use irregular past forms for finished actions; use did/didn't (+ base verb) for questions and negatives.
when_to_use_ar: نستخدم صيغ الماضي الشاذة للأحداث المنتهية، و did/didn't مع الفعل المجرد للأسئلة والنفي.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners add -ed to irregular verbs ('goed') and keep the past form after 'did' ('Did you went?'). After did/didn't the verb must return to its base form.
quick_rule: Irregular = new word (went, saw, bought). After did/didn't → base verb.
quick_rule_ar: الشاذ = كلمة جديدة (went, saw). وبعد did/didn't → الفعل المجرد.
connect_to_speaking: Ask and answer: 'Did you go out yesterday?' 'Yes, I went to a café and saw a friend.'
